quarterly_data.signal: Second quarter total revenue was $3.3 billion, up 12% year over year, including an approximate 170 basis point benefit from foreign exchange rates. Global CF revenue grew 11%, CASGEVY delivered $76 million compared with $30 million in Q2 2025 and JOURNAVX delivered $50 million compared with $12 million.

Second quarter non-GAAP R&D expense was $889 million, up 1% year over year, with steady progress across multiple phase III studies and the earlier stage pipeline. Management said R&D accounts for nearly two-thirds of operating expenses and that the modest growth rate reflects redeploying dollars from programs that wind down to programs that are new or scaling up. Non-GAAP SG&A was $520 million, up 45%, and $21 million of acquired IPR&D expense was recorded in the quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D $889M (+1%); nearly 2/3 of operating expenses; SG&A $520M (+45%); acquired IPR&D $21M

quarterly_data.signal: The renal franchise has four programs in mid- and late-stage development: povetacicept in IgA nephropathy and primary membranous nephropathy, inaxaplin in APOL1-mediated kidney disease and VX-407 in ADPKD. In cystic fibrosis VX-828 recently completed dosing in the patient cohort, with VX-581 and VX-272 in healthy volunteer studies. The FDA also cleared the IND for VX-017, the type O or universal donor islet cell product, which management said would double the Type 1 Diabetes market opportunity from about 60,000 to about 120,000 patients.
quarterly_data.figure: 4 renal programs; VX-828, VX-581 and VX-272 next-gen CFTR correctors; T1D opportunity ~60,000 to ~120,000 patients

quarterly_data.signal: The BLA for povetacicept in IgA nephropathy was accepted in the U.S. with a November 30th PDUFA date and the company is in the final stages of commercial launch preparation, having completed hiring of a renal field force of whom about 90% have nephrology experience. Interim analysis results from the AMPLITUDE phase III study in AMKD remain on track for early 2027, AMPLIFY results are expected this fall and initial VX-828 patient data in the second half of this year.
quarterly_data.figure: PDUFA November 30th; ~90% of renal field force with nephrology experience; AMPLITUDE IA early 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Vertex announced a definitive agreement to acquire Crinetics Pharmaceuticals for approximately $8.8 billion net of cash acquired, funded through a combination of cash on hand and proceeds from a $4.5 billion term loan. Management said the two lead assets, paltusotine and atumelnant, together represent a peak sales opportunity of about $5 billion, and expects the transaction to become accretive to non-GAAP operating income in 2029. Quarter-end cash and investments were approximately $13.6 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: $8.8B net of cash acquired; $4.5B term loan; ~$5B peak sales opportunity; accretive 2029; cash and investments ~$13.6B

quarterly_data.signal: Full year 2026 total revenue guidance was raised to a range of $13.1 billion-$13.2 billion, still including revenue of $500 million or greater from non-CF products and an expected 150 basis point benefit from foreign exchange net of hedging. Full year gross margin is expected to be just under 86% and combined non-GAAP operating expense guidance of $5.65 billion-$5.75 billion was reiterated, though now expected at the high end of that range. Guidance does not yet reflect the pending Crinetics acquisition.
quarterly_data.figure: FY revenue $13.1B-$13.2B; non-CF revenue >=$500M; gross margin just under 86%; opex $5.65B-$5.75B
